_pack.name: messaging-agent
_pack.description: For an agent that posts messages or sends email. Refuses a message body or recipient derived from tool output, and asks a human. Measured on AgentDojo slack: 46 attacks to 22 at zero benign cost, where a params-only engine caught nothing. Does NOT catch a body the model paraphrased: whole-argument provenance fires on verbatim survival only.
_pack.scope: Free-text bodies cannot be allowlisted, so this leans entirely on provenance. Start in shadow.
